# EasyOpenHub (拿来就用)

> Hand-picked free open-source apps, AI tools, games and courses that ordinary people can download and use, each explained in plain English and Chinese: what it does, who it is for, what paid product it replaces, how to install it safely.

## Guide
- [How to download from GitHub safely](https://easyopenhub.com/en/guide/)
